summary: Kerb by a vacant block near a junction; homes about 10-12 m either side.
reasons: Homes 10-11 m along the same side

drivers.seclusion: Vacant dirt block beside the kerb, but houses sit 10-11 m away just north and south on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and a dirt apron into the vacant block; a van can pull off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Short quiet street just below a cross street; low traffic.
drivers.convention: One car parks nearby on the street; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 7% grade here, 10% over the whole stretch
sun_shade: Open dirt to the east; trees shade the north end of the kerb in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the vacant block is fenced

best_section.where: East kerb beside the vacant block, 30 m south of the cross street
